order_book: And order book at the end of the quarter was INR2,315 crores while Q1 order book was INR1,529 crores.
And from an order book mix, 96% of India and 4% of international.
guidance: The high levels of inventory, we expect a significant portion of the inventories would be utilized in executing the BSNL 4G order in the coming quarters, for which the deliveries have already started in Q2 FY27.
So all of INR1,500 crores is not there in the order book yet, but they will come -- most of it, we expect to come by the end of this quarter.
capex: And the key reason was because of our order book being -- it was a receipt of the LOI and subsequent POs for 18,000 -plus 4G sites for the BSNL 4G network expansion.
So looking forward, some of the key business drivers in wireless continues to be the expansion of 5G deployment in emerging markets and the 5G rollouts, which are supposed to continue until 2030.
focus: This is, again, a new customer footprint that we have won in that continent.

We also have a strategic focus on addressing data center interconnect applications as those build- outs continue to happen and grow and as the -- especially as the investments in AI data center starts happening in India.
We'll have increased focus on collections.

about: Incorporated in 2000,Tejas Networks Ltd designs and manufactures wireline and wireless networking products, with a focus on technology, innovation  and  R&D.  TNL carrier-class  products  are  used  by  telecom  service  providers,  utilities,  governments,  and  defence networks in 75+ countries.  Company  is  currently  a  part  of  Panatone  Finvest  Limited  (a  subsidiary  of  Tata  Sons  Private Limited). [1]
